scoring_justification: The angular dispersion is recomputed from the raw emissivity matrix and compared against the paper's reported value with monotonic threshold scoring.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported angular dispersion (Δθ) for SiC/graphene-bundle/Si-grating with period Λ=37.51 µm, τ=200 fs (Fig. 5 text). Used as reference threshold.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Physical Review B 96, 125407 (2017), Section IV, text: 'The computed emissivity pattern ... demonstrates angular dispersion of around 4.2°'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The value is explicitly stated in the paper as the numerical result for the studied configuration.

schema.description: Columns: wavelength_um (float); one column per angle from -90 to 90 deg in 0.5 deg steps, named angle_{deg} (e.g., angle_-90, angle_-89.5, ...), values float emissivity in [0,1]. One row per wavelength.

outputs.description: Raw angle- and frequency-resolved emissivity matrix. The checker recomputes angular dispersion Δθ from this data and compares to the paper's reference value.

schema.description: A single float value (in degrees) representing the maximum full-width half-maximum of the emissivity peak over 11–12 µm.

outputs.description: The agent's computed angular dispersion Δθ; checked against a hidden golden threshold.

output_contract.notes: The checker will primarily recompute Δθ from emissivity_data.csv. angular_dispersion.txt provides a quick consistency check.
